name: amazon-ops-copilot
description: Shared memory and follow-through for Amazon sellers who use AI, with any data source: KwickMetrics (built in), another connector, or reports you upload. Changes made through a connected tool are logged automatically, and analyses or decisions you approve, to your private GitHub repo, with the AI tool, model and data source. Claude checks the last 90 days before suggesting anything, reviews whether changes worked, and Codex, Grok and Cursor pick up the same history.
